answer: A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The dawn counter is kept in inlet and zenith publishes each reset. Someone thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4598 identities would post 2963 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
